category: Motorbike rental — original passport retained as deposit
signals: Damage policy resolved by cash at return time (no neutral inspection, no insurer)
No written rental contract or itemized receipt offered
Shop is not listed in the verified rental operator directory
next_steps: Do not hand over your original passport. Offer a photocopy of the passport ID page plus a cash deposit (typical 2,000-5,000 THB for a scooter).
Ask for a written rental contract that lists the daily rate, the damage policy, the deposit amount, and the return time before you sign or pay.
Photograph the entire scooter from 8 angles (front, back, both sides, both mirrors, seat, undercarriage) and ride briefly with the shop staff to confirm the condition.
If the shop refuses, walk away and use a hotel-recommended rental, Grab Bike rentals, or one of the TAT-verified Patong operators in the trusted-operator directory.
Save the shop name, exact address, and a photo of the contract template; if they keep your passport against your will from inside the shop, contact Tourist Police 1155.
why_it_matters: Surrendering an original passport creates pressure leverage that the rental shop can use during a later damage dispute. The Royal Thai Police, Tourist Police 1155, and most embassies recommend never leaving an original passport as deposit for a vehicle rental. Combined with a 'cash now, no insurer, no police' damage policy, the situation matches the documented Patong scooter-rental pressure pattern that has cost tourists 10,000-50,000 THB in cash 'damage' claims for pre-existing scratches.
thai_phrase: ขอใช้สำเนาพาสปอร์ตและวางเงินมัดจำแทนตัวจริงได้ไหมครับ/ค่ะ และขอสัญญาเช่าเป็นลายลักษณ์อักษร
evidence_to_save: Photos of the scooter from all angles BEFORE you ride
Shop name, exact address (Google Maps pin), and Google Maps phone number
Daily rate, deposit amount, and damage policy as written
Names of any shop staff who handle your passport
Receipt or written acknowledgement of any cash you pay
contact_recommendation: Do not pay or hand over the passport until the terms are written and clear. If the shop refuses a passport copy or refuses a written contract, simply walk away — there are many alternatives in Patong. Tourist Police 1155 is appropriate only if your passport has already been taken and the shop refuses to return it, if you are pressured or threatened, or if your insurer / embassy advises escalation.

grounding.title: Passport-retention rental pattern
grounding.summary: The shop is asking the tourist to leave the original passport as deposit and to settle damage in cash at return time with no insurer and no police. Both signals are documented levers for the Patong scooter-rental pressure pattern. Safer alternative: passport photocopy + 2,000-5,000 THB cash deposit + written contract + pre-rental photos.

This combination removes neutral inspection and creates leverage for inflated damage claims at return time. Documented Patong cases have escalated 200 THB scratches into 15,000-50,000 THB 'damage' demands when the original passport was held by the shop.

grounding.title: Patong scooter-rental hot-zone
grounding.summary: Soi Rat-U-Thit and the central Patong beach road have the highest number of reported scooter-rental damage disputes in Phuket according to the Phuket Tourist Police 1155 dashboard. Passport-retention is a documented pressure script in this area.
